interface.title: ProtoRepair
interface.field: Battery research / electrochemistry (NMC811 || Li-metal coin cells)
interface.stage_of_work: Pre-experiment protocol review (pre-flight check before cell assembly)
interface.what_it_is_for: Reads an NMC811||Li-metal coin-cell assembly protocol, checks its arithmetic and stated limits (composition, loading/capacity, Li excess, electrolyte fill, water budget, glovebox atmosphere) without guessing missing values, and gives a READY / REVIEW / NOT READY verdict with one proposed local patch per finding.

data.note: Most work used the built-in 'Example protocol' fixtures (G14 clean control, G02, H2, Demo composite H1+H3+H4, P4). The test files G14.txt, G04.txt and G02.txt were also uploaded, and protocol text was edited by hand. Gemini reading stayed disabled because GEMINI_API_KEY is not set. Nothing needed a network connection.

tree.general: Check an experimental procedure for internal inconsistencies and get a go/no-go verdict with minimal proposed fixes before running the experiment
tree.specific: Pre-flight check an NMC811||Li coin-cell assembly protocol and get READY/REVIEW/NOT READY with per-finding local patches

features.name: Severity-graded readiness verdict panel
features.general: Sum rule-check results into a traffic-light go/no-go verdict with counts per severity and a one-line reason
features.specific: Readiness: READY / REVIEW / NOT READY banner with Critical/High/Medium/Low counters, 'N fail · N unknown · N proposed patch(es) · extraction: structured|deterministic|structured+overrides', and the rule text (any Critical/High → NOT READY; Medium or material unknown → REVIEW)
steps: load or edit a protocol
run deterministic checks
read the verdict colour and severity counts
read the extraction mode and the rule sentence
serves_tasks: Confirm a known-good reference procedure passes
Edit the procedure text and re-run to see the verdict change
Review several simultaneous faults, each with its own fix

features.name: Finding card with diff-style local patch and patched-text preview
features.general: Show each problem with its rule ID, status, severity, explanation, source quote and evidence, plus a minimal one-line red/green fix that can be previewed in context and is re-checked automatically
features.specific: Finding cards (e.g. 'B2 · FAIL · HIGH') with confidence/detection, a quote, evidence IDs, 'Proposed local patch (preview only; never merged)' as a − / + diff, a 'Preview patched text' button showing the full patched protocol, and a 'Patch validity: target finding removed on rerun; no new fail' check. UNKNOWN cards say 'Unknown is REVIEW-level; no invented value.'
steps: open the Findings tab
read the finding's status, severity, explanation and quote
read the − / + local patch
press Preview patched text
read the patch-validity result
serves_tasks: Inspect a seeded arithmetic inconsistency and its proposed fix
Review several simultaneous faults, each with its own fix
Review unknowns that block a clean pass
